question.text: From a balloon rising vertically with uniform velocity $\mathrm{ft} / \mathrm{sec}$ a piece of stone is let go. The height of the balloon above the ground when the stone reaches the ground after $4 \mathrm{sec}$ is $\left[\mathrm{g}=32 \mathrm{ft} / \mathrm{sec}^2\right]$

solution.text:
When stone is let go, its velocity $=-v$ (downwards)
Let, it was at a height h.
$\therefore h=-v t+\frac{1}{2} gt^2$
$\begin{aligned}
&=-v \times 4+\frac{1}{2} \times 32 \times 4^2 \\
&=-4 v+256
\end{aligned}$
Balloon reaches $4 \mathrm{vtt}$ in 4 seconds
$\therefore$ height required $=4 v+h=256 \mathrm{ft}$
